title: Potato+
description: A Lightweight Modpack to Massively Boost FPS on Your Potato PC.
body:
## Features

### Performance
Using modern performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and other optimization utilities. The bundled mods have been carefully selected to be safe in your worlds and provide noticeable speed benefits on any device.

### Graphics
It supports most OptiFine features, including shaders, connected textures, and zoom. If your resource pack states "OptiFine required," it will most likely function perfectly here as well.

### Familiarity
It includes features that allow you to experience Minecraft just as you remember it, no matter what version you have used before. This means you can easily play local worlds with friends, view advancements in a large window, and navigate optimized settings menus.

### Compatibility
It does not include content mods, so you can play on any world or vanilla server. While you can use any game launcher to play the pack, we recommend using launchers that easily support Fabric modpacks for the best experience.

### Updates
It receives fast updates and aims to be one of the first modpacks to upgrade to newer Minecraft versions. Updating the modpack is simple and will preserve your mod settings wherever possible.

### Engine
It uses the Fabric mod loader, which is lightweight, fast, and supports a massive library of mods. You can use this modpack as a solid, optimized base to add your own favorite mods too.

### Development
It relies on open-source solutions, and so do most of its bundled mods. We welcome user suggestions and work to create a clean, accessible user experience for everyone.

## FAQ

**Q: How do I install, update, or add mods?**  
A: You can manage the pack directly through your preferred modpack launcher or check our documentation pages.

**Q: Something broke or I want to suggest a feature.**  
A: Please report bugs and suggestions directly via our official email address.

**Q: What mods does it have?**  
A: Click on the specific version download and scroll down to see the complete, transparent mod list.

**Q: Do I need this modpack on the server?**  
A: No. The pack runs entirely on the client side and works on all multiplayer servers that allow vanilla clients.

**Q: Have more questions or need to get in touch.**  
A: For official inquiries, support, or direct contact, you can reach out to us via email at moohsinplaysofficial@gmail.com.
